title: Carrot Ginger Soup with Spinach
description: Carrot Ginger Soup with Spinach. A warm fluid-rich option to accompany hydration and a balanced diet.
whyItWorks: Broth provides fluid, and ingredients may contribute minerals; sodium depends strongly on the stock and added salt.

ingredients.item: Main ingredient for Carrot Ginger Soup

steps: Wash and prepare the vegetables and other ingredients.
Simmer gently in water or unsalted stock until all ingredients are fully cooked.
Serve warm; add salt only as appropriate for your dietary needs.
